## R9 closure

- The production cancellation defect is closed. `validateExactFocusReadback` carries the exact live probe and immutable deadline into `copyAttribute` and distinguishes cancellation, deadline, unavailable, and failed outcomes before any later readback (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1256-1283`). The concrete helper requires the probe, checks it before and after the messaging-timeout return and after `AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue`, and cannot silently select a default false probe (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1637-1673`). The accepted executor invokes only the cancellation-aware validation overload with the exact handle probe (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:900-916`). Explicit `{ false }` calls remain structurally limited to capture-time operations and the named no-probe compatibility entry point; no validation-critical helper parameter has a default false value.
- The prior self-shrinking oracle is closed. The test owns a hand-authored inventory of all 15 current production `ReviewAXStepID` cases and fixed binding-specific occurrence sequences (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:3354-3433`). It asserts count, uniqueness, classification of the capture-only `isAttributeSettable` ID, inclusion of late readback/editability steps, and both leading and trailing security composites before scenarios are created (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:744-793`).
- Exact validation now uses a real attached editable `NSTextView` and application AX root; application-bound validation uses a real application root with an ordinary focused-element miss (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:3436-3545`). Both successful concrete traces must equal their fixed expected arrays exactly before the matrix runs (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:795-842`). A missing, reordered, additional, or early-terminated reachable validation step therefore fails instead of shrinking the scenario set.
- The matrix derives occurrence numbers from the fixed arrays, creates a fresh concrete fixture for every row, injects live cancellation and separately absolute-deadline expiry after each concrete observed return, requires the typed result, and proves no later step executes (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:3155-3251`). This covers repeated timeout/security occurrences as well as focused copy, selected-range copy, AX value readback, role/subrole reads, captured PID readback, and the trailing composite for exact; application-bound covers its ordinary miss and trailing composite. The capture-only settable operation is explicitly outside attempt cancellation authority and remains classified in the complete 15-ID inventory.
- The two concrete late-focus-readback tests remain end-to-end: one exercises the real System runtime and one carries the same interleaving through `ReviewSubmissionExecutor`, both proving cancellation immediately after the readback timeout prevents the following copy, pair construction, down, and up (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:540-742`).
- The nine late deadline failures exposed by the fixed oracle are repaired without weakening security. Internal AX element, string, range, PID, settable, editable, and operation results preserve a distinct `.deadline`; validation maps it to `.accessibilityTimeout`, while genuine unavailable, malformed, secure, untrusted, identity, frontmost, and AX failure outcomes retain their prior fail-closed classifications (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:699-768,1029-1105,1161-1356,1376-1599`). The low-level post-return checkpoints remain before all later AX work (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1613-2005`).

## Prior closure and user-contract regression review

- R10 remains closed. The immutable Unicode pair is constructed and read back once before commit (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:846-858`). Every retry starts with full immediate target/security validation before modifiers and reservations; unavailable epoch or value-lock reservations return to that validation without reconstructing the pair (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:967-1005`). The only post-capable section contains the mandatory down/up pair at lines 1021-1031.
- R11 remains closed. `ReviewConfirmationIntent` construction is fileprivate and limited to real Send-button and qualified-preview-Return factories (`FeishuSpeech/Controllers/ReviewWindowController.swift:11-35,410,703`). The retained `.nonactivatingPanel` is the single native key-event arbiter; it rejects repeat, modifier, wrong-window, non-descendant-responder, IME-marked, and whitespace-only confirmation events (`FeishuSpeech/Controllers/ReviewWindowController.swift:38-113,282,669-704`). The executable real-panel matrix still sends Return/keypad Enter and all rejection variants through production `ReviewPanel.sendEvent`, with no test-side intent minting.
- Expired-start security R3 remains closed. An admitted record that expires before start is removed, clears only its matching active handle, emits exactly one deadline terminal outside the lock, and invokes no raw start (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:176-203`). Later cancellation and cleanup cannot emit a second terminal (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:206-265`). The coordinator retains the frozen draft and restores editable state for every preboundary terminal (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:2315-2340,2377-2413`).
- The accepted app still defaults to `SystemReviewSubmissionFacade` with legacy delivery absent (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:375-376`). Before a real preview-local Send or qualified Return, no attempt is issued and no output-capable action occurs. After confirmation, the accepted path creates one handle/envelope and can make exactly one immutable Unicode down/up attempt to the captured positive PID. Production contains no clipboard read/write, Cmd+V, application activation, or ambient retarget route.
- A submitted-unverified terminal remains terminal: the coordinator clears the handle and authority, releases the target, dismisses the review, clears the draft, and returns idle; late receipts cannot match and no resend path remains (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:2315-2375`).
- MainActor admission, start, cancellation, and release remain asynchronous queue operations. Recording and recognition remain independent `captureDrainTask` and `consumerTask` roots (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:303-304,714-719`). The protected recorder, streaming actor, API, ingress, and journal topology is unchanged; only `HotKeyService.swift` remains in the protected-file diff for interference-epoch handling.
